title: Senior Business Manager
description:
1. Be responsible for the development of the local non-ferrous mineral market in the target country (products include but are not limited to: copper, lead, zinc, lithium, nickel, etc.), contact and visit customers of mining resources, factory customers and customers of export business, and maintain customer relationships regularly;


2. Assist the company in maintaining relationships with existing clients, handling, reporting and resolving unexpected issues during business advancement.


3. Actively maintain communication and coordination with local ports and relevant government departments to ensure the smooth operation of business.


4. Have a global perspective to empower overseas business;


5. Other tasks assigned by leaders.



Application requirements


Full-time bachelor's degree is required. Major is not limited. Those who can communicate in Chinese with the local language of the target country are preferred.


2. Candidates with more than three years of relevant experience in international trade and familiarity with the overseas market conditions of mineral products are preferred.


3. Outgoing personality, with a strong sense of personal achievement and self-motivation, and a strong sense of career.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Sobre a Nuvia

A Nuvia é a plataforma de AI-Powered Growth para vendas B2B. No ano passado, fechamos uma rodada com NXTP Ventures, Gilgamesh Ventures, 16|16 Ventures, LASP Capital e o scout fund da a16z e logo depois adquirimos a Datasaga.ai (consultoria de dados e IA para vendas) para acelerar nossa operação.

Não vendemos promessa, entregamos pipeline. Com isso, nossos clientes têm em média, +35% de conversão e -50% no custo de aquisição de clientes.

Agora estamos expandindo o time que vai escalar isso para centenas de empresas (nacionais e internacionais). Se você quer ajudar construir a máquina de vendas do futuro (e não só operar ferramentas) esse é o seu lugar.


Seu Papel


O Data Analyst (com foco em Data Hacking) (como o próprio nome diz) é uma posição que mistura habilidades de Data Analysis com Growth Hacking e é um elemento chave na implantação do Nuvia Growth System em nossos clientes. 

Você vai ser a inteligência por trás dos dados que alimentam toda a operação de vendas - nossa e dos nossos clientes. Enquanto o GTM Engineer executa campanhas, você descobre quem são os alvos, quais sinais indicam intenção de compra, e constrói os pipelines que entregam esses dados de forma contínua e escalável.

Você vai operar na interseção de dados, scraping e automação . Se você nunca raspou dados de uma fonte não-óbvia, se não sabe o que é um waterfall de enriquecimento, ou se acha que "pegar dados" é exportar CSV do LinkedIn Sales Navigator - essa vaga não é pra você.

Seu trabalho não termina na lista. Você vai produtizar e escalar esses pipelines para injetar dados continuamente no nosso Datalake, alimentando AI Agents e operações de dezenas de clientes simultaneamente.


O que você vai fazer

  • Descobrir e mapear fontes de dados para construção de listas qualificadas (APIs públicas, scraping, bases alternativas, sinais de intenção)
  • Construir pipelines de enriquecimento que transformam nome de empresa em perfil completo com decisores, tecnologias, sinais e scores
  • Desenvolver e manter scrapers que capturam dados de forma contínua e confiável (sem quebrar toda semana)
  • Produtizar pipelines de dados para alimentar o Datalake da Nuvia de forma contínua.
  • Identificar e capturar sinais de intenção (contratações, funding, mudanças de stack, vagas abertas, expansão)
  • Criar waterfalls de enriquecimento que maximizam cobertura com menor custo (Apollo → Clearbit → Hunter → fallback)
  • Garantir qualidade e padronização dos dados (deduplicação, normalização, validação)
  • Documentar fontes, lógicas e pipelines para escalar a operação sem depender de você e para te liberar para construir coisas ainda mais legais (como modelos de leadsocre, assertividade de dados, dentre outros). 


Quem você é hoje

Você é Data Analyst, BI Analyst, ou Growth Analyst em uma startup B2B que precisava de dados que não existiam prontos — e você foi atrás.

Você já construiu scrapers que funcionam, já integrou APIs obscuras, já montou pipelines de enriquecimento que rodaram por meses sem quebrar. Entende que dado bom é dado limpo, atualizado e acionável.

Ou:  

Você era dev/analista que se especializou em dados de growth porque percebeu que a vantagem competitiva está em saber coisas que os outros não sabem . Você já raspou dados que ninguém tinha pedido, só porque viu oportunidade.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • 2-4 anos de experiência com dados para growth, sales ops, ou lead gen (B2B)
  • Python intermediário — scraping (BeautifulSoup, Selenium, Playwright), APIs, manipulação de dados (Pandas), automação de pipelines
  • SQL intermediário — queries complexas, joins, agregações, CTEs. Você vai viver no banco.
  • APIs de dados — já consumiu Apollo, Clearbit, Hunter, Crunchbase, LinkedIn (oficial ou não), ou similares
  • N8N ou Make — workflows de enriquecimento, transformação, roteamento de dados
  • Experiência real com scraping — já construiu scrapers que rodaram em produção, não só tutorial
  • Noção de qualidade de dados — sabe o que é deduplicação, normalização, validação, cobertura
  • Noção de arquitetura de dados — entende conceito de data lake, ETL/ELT, batch vs streaming


Diferenciais que pesam


  • Experiência com Databricks, Spark, ou PySpark
  • Conhecimento de Delta Lake, Apache Airflow, ou orquestração de pipelines
  • Já trabalhou com ingestão de dados em data lakes (não só consulta)
  • Experiência com Clay (enrichment, waterfalls, AI columns)
  • Conhecimento de Phantombuster, Firecrawl, Apify, Bright Data, ScrapingBee ou ferramentas similares
  • Experiência com bases de dados alternativas (job boards, registro de empresas, patents, news)
  • Conhecimento de proxies, rotação de IPs, anti-bot bypass
  • Background em BI ou analytics (Power BI, Metabase, Looker)
  • Inglês intermediário (muita documentação e fonte de dados em inglês)


O que você NÃO é

  • Analista de BI que só sabe fazer dashboard bonito mas nunca foi atrás do dado na fonte
  • Dev que acha scraping "sujo" e prefere esperar API oficial que nunca vai existir
  • Pessoa que depende de ferramenta pronta: se não existe, você constrói
  • Quem precisa de especificação detalhada pra começar a resolver um problema
  • Quem entrega lista uma vez e esquece - aqui é pipeline contínuo com otimização focada em gerar resultados para nossos clientes.


Modelo de contratação e Benefícios

  • Posição remota ou híbrida
  • Remuneração competitiva com variável por entrega
  • Contratação PJ
  • Benefícios de saúde/alimentação
  • Verba para cursos e formações em Dados/Automações/AI

title: Senior Technical Writer
description:
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa para o papel de Tech Writer para atuar na documentação de usabilidade de sistemas ERP. Você fará parte de um time inovador, ajudando a estruturar e escalar a documentação técnica de um ecossistema em crescimento.


Sua missão será criar conteúdos claros, acessíveis e bem estruturados para a Central de Ajuda, facilitando a adoção e o uso de nossas soluções por clientes, parceiros e stakeholders.

Se você tem experiência com documentação técnica de software, especialmente ERP, e deseja contribuir para a escalabilidade e padronização de conteúdos, essa vaga é para você!


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Produzir, manter e evoluir a documentação técnica de sistema ERP, garantindo clareza, precisão e acessibilidade.
  • Criar e atualizar conteúdos para a Central de Ajuda, melhorando a experiência do usuário e facilitando o autoatendimento.
  • Escrever textos otimizados para usuários e IA, garantindo que a documentação possa ser interpretada eficientemente por assistentes digitais e ferramentas de IA.
  • Utilizar IA para escalar e padronizar a documentação técnica.
  • Aplicar princípios de arquitetura da informação para facilitar a navegação e a busca por conteúdos.
  • Desenvolver estratégias para escalabilidade e padronização da produção de conteúdos técnicos utilizando ferramentas de IA.
  • Manter boas práticas de versionamento e gerenciamento de documentação utilizando GitHub.
  • Fazer a publicação de conteúdos no Zendesk.
  • Colaborar com os times de Produto, Engenharia e UX para alinhar a documentação às necessidades dos usuários.
  • Medir e otimizar continuamente a documentação com base em feedback dos usuários e métricas de usabilidade.



REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Formação em Letras, Comunicação, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência comprovada com documentação técnica.
  • Experiência com Markdown e versionamento de documentação com Git.
  • Familiaridade com o VS Code.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de documentação técnica como Confluence, GitBook, ReadMe e Swagger.
  • Habilidade para estruturar documentações técnicas de forma clara e objetiva, priorizando a experiência do usuário.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em colaboração com times técnicos e de produto.


DIFERENCIAIS (Desejável)

  • Experiência com documentação de ERPs do mercado.
  • Conhecimento em métricas para avaliar a eficácia da documentação.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Conhecimento sobre documentação de APIs, integrações e workflows de ERPs.


Se você busca um desafio para liderar a evolução tecnológica de um dos maiores ERPs do país, com impacto direto na experiência de milhares de usuários, queremos te conhecer!

title: 3D Designer - Cinema 4D Specialist (Product, Commercial)
description:
Contractor/Freelance Position | 100% Remote (Full-Time)


We are specifically looking to review portfolios from individuals based in Brazil and Argentina .


About the role

We are seeking a talented Cinema 4D Designer to join our Creative team, specializing in high-fidelity, marketing-grade 3D rendering, imagery, and product animation. This role is responsible for generating stunning, hyper-realistic 3D visuals, clean motion assets, and sophisticated compositing work (photomontages) across our diverse portfolio of brands. This position requires exceptional skill in achieving professional authenticity and meticulous attention to detail. You will collaborate closely with Graphic Designers and other team members to translate creative concepts into precise, high-quality visuals, ensuring consistent and professional execution for all our business-focused content.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop high-end, hyper-realistic product and lifestyle scenes, including advanced image compositing (photomontages), from various reference materials.
  • Create professional 3D product animations (e.g., product rotations, camera moves, and simple showcases).
  • Help us set new standards for the modeling, texturing, lighting of our products, with an absolute dedication to visual authenticity.
  • Accurately translate design concepts into detailed 3D models.
  • Develop high-resolution final images and video assets of rendered content.
  • Successfully balance and prioritise multiple projects simultaneously to meet deadlines.
  • Work with varied project briefs, cooperate with Graphic Designers, and support the wider Creative team.
  • Ensure adherence to brand guidelines, adapting to the distinct visual approaches required for our various brands.
  • Uphold design standards, including consistent file-naming structures and meticulous folder organisation.


Requirements

  • Mandatory: Expert proficiency in Cinema 4D. Please note that this is a strict requirement; we are not seeking users of Blender, 3ds Max, or Maya for this role. Experience with Octane Render is highly preferred.
  • You possess a strong portfolio that showcases expertise in high-definition, commercial-style 3D visualizations, expert image compositing, and 3D animation. Portfolios focused only on character design, game assets, or abstract/fantasy scenes are not suitable for this role.
  • Mandatory: Excellent verbal and written English communication skills are required. You must be able to fluently communicate and clearly articulate technical 3D constraints to non-technical team members.
  • You have 4+ years’ experience as a 3D designer. Ideally, you’ll have worked in a graphic/animation studio, advertising agency, or an in-house creative department and have some experience working with beauty or wellness products.
  • You possess a proactive interest in emerging 3D technologies and have a willingness to explore AI-powered tools to optimize workflows and push creative boundaries.
  • You are capable of assessing a brief and determining the most effective execution strategy - knowing when to push for technical excellence and when to utilise smart shortcuts to meet tight turnarounds.
  • You are educated to degree level in Design or a related subject (e.g., Graphic Design, Product Design, Animation, or Motion Design).
  • You are proficient in modeling and texturing, and can create stunning, life-like visual assets of packaging, single products, and detailed marketing scenes. Your output must demonstrate strict adherence to photographic quality and detail.
  • You have expertise in lighting set-up, colour, and shading, with a keen focus on optimal product presentation to achieve visual authenticity.
  • You have a superb sense of composition, visual veracity (truthfulness), texture, and illumination, and a sophisticated understanding of materials. You can view products from a customer's perspective.
  • You are highly skilled with Adobe Photoshop (essential for compositing/photomontages) and knowledgeable about the broader Adobe Creative Suite.
  • You can effectively plan, prioritise, and problem-solve in a fast-paced environment, and manage multiple projects simultaneously.


To apply:

Please submit your CV and portfolio. Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed.

This position requires exceptional skill in achieving professional authenticity and meticulous attention to detail. You will collaborate closely with Graphic Designers and other team members to translate creative concepts into precise, high-quality visuals, ensuring consistent and professional execution for all our business-focused content.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop high-end, hyper-realistic product and lifestyle scenes, including advanced image compositing (photomontages), from various reference materials.
  • Create professional 3D product animations (e.g., product rotations, camera moves, and simple showcases).
  • Help us set new standards for the modeling, texturing, lighting of our products, with an absolute dedication to visual authenticity.
  • Accurately translate design concepts into detailed 3D models.
  • Develop high-resolution final images and video assets of rendered content.
  • Successfully balance and prioritise multiple projects simultaneously to meet deadlines.
  • Work with varied project briefs, cooperate with Graphic Designers, and support the wider Creative team.
  • Ensure adherence to brand guidelines, adapting to the distinct visual approaches required for our various brands.
  • Uphold design standards, including consistent file-naming structures and meticulous folder organisation.


Requirements

  • Mandatory: Expert proficiency in Cinema 4D. Please note that this is a strict requirement; we are not seeking users of Blender, 3ds Max, or Maya for this role. Experience with Octane Render is highly preferred.
  • You possess a strong portfolio that showcases expertise in high-definition, commercial-style 3D visualizations, expert image compositing, and 3D animation. Portfolios focused only on character design, game assets, or abstract/fantasy scenes are not suitable for this role.
  • Mandatory: Excellent verbal and written English communication skills are required. You must be able to fluently communicate and clearly articulate technical 3D constraints to non-technical team members.
  • You have 4+ years’ experience as a 3D designer. Ideally, you’ll have worked in a graphic/animation studio, advertising agency, or an in-house creative department and have some experience working with beauty or wellness products.
  • You possess a proactive interest in emerging 3D technologies and have a willingness to explore AI-powered tools to optimize workflows and push creative boundaries.
  • You are capable of assessing a brief and determining the most effective execution strategy - knowing when to push for technical excellence and when to utilise smart shortcuts to meet tight turnarounds.
  • You are educated to degree level in Design or a related subject (e.g., Graphic Design, Product Design, Animation, or Motion Design).
  • You are proficient in modeling and texturing, and can create stunning, life-like visual assets of packaging, single products, and detailed marketing scenes. Your output must demonstrate strict adherence to photographic quality and detail.
  • You have expertise in lighting set-up, colour, and shading, with a keen focus on optimal product presentation to achieve visual authenticity.
  • You have a superb sense of composition, visual veracity (truthfulness), texture, and illumination, and a sophisticated understanding of materials. You can view products from a customer's perspective.
  • You are highly skilled with Adobe Photoshop (essential for compositing/photomontages) and knowledgeable about the broader Adobe Creative Suite.
  • You can effectively plan, prioritise, and problem-solve in a fast-paced environment, and manage multiple projects simultaneously.


To apply:

Please submit your CV and portfolio. Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed.

title: ServiceNow Developer
description:
Apricot Jam


Apricot Jam is a US based consulting and technology company working with Fortune 500 and large enterprise clients worldwide. We design and deliver next generation enterprise solutions combining ServiceNow, AI driven automation, and strong engineering practices.


Our teams operate across Europe the US and Asia, working in a culture that values ownership, curiosity, and continuous growth. We believe great software is built by people who care deeply about quality, collaboration, and impact.


Role Overview


We are looking for skilled ServiceNow Developers to join our growing delivery team. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy building modern enterprise applications and want to work across advanced ServiceNow capabilities including UI Builder, AI Agent Studio, App Engine, and ERP focused integrations.


You will work closely with solution architects, functional consultants, and client stakeholders to design and implement scalable solutions on the ServiceNow platform. The more of the skills below you bring, the more impact you can have.


What You Will Do


• Design configure and develop custom solutions on the ServiceNow platform

• Build modern user experiences using UI Builder and Next Experience

• Develop applications using App Engine including ERP related use cases

• Configure and extend workflows using Flow Designer and platform automation

• Implement integrations using IntegrationHub REST and Zero Copy Connector patterns

• Work with AI Agent Studio and Now Assist related capabilities where applicable

• Translate business requirements into clean scalable technical solutions

• Participate in technical workshops solution reviews and demos

• Collaborate with global teams across Europe and the US

• Contribute to best practices performance optimization and platform governance


Required and Desired Skills


• 3 plus years of hands on ServiceNow development experience

• Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal

• Strong JavaScript skills including client and server side scripting

• Experience with one or more of the following is highly valued

• UI Builder and custom workspace development

• AI Agent Studio or Now Assist related configurations

• App Engine Studio and custom application development

• ERP related ServiceNow use cases

• ERP Canvas and Zero Copy Connector experience

• Solid understanding of ServiceNow data models security and performance

• Experience with Flow Designer IntegrationHub and APIs

• Ability to work in a client facing environment


Certifications are a strong plus

• CSA CAD

• CIS certifications ITSM CSM HRSD ITAM or App Engine


Why Join Apricot Jam


• Work on complex high impact ServiceNow implementations for US enterprise clients

• Be part of a senior globally distributed ServiceNow team

• Exposure to cutting edge ServiceNow capabilities including AI and ERP integrations

• Support for certifications learning and career growth

• Competitive compensation based on experience and contribution

• A people first culture built on trust autonomy and collaboration

title: Clinical Trainer LATAM
description:
About Lumenis

Lumenis is a world leader in laser- and light-based technologies for medical and aesthetic applications. Ever since introducing the first medical laser system in the world nearly 45 years ago, Lumenis has been at the forefront of technological innovation and market leadership in its segment. Today, Lumenis offers a wide range of products, an unparalleled technical support system, the largest global installed-base of medical laser products and one of the largest investments in research and development in the industry. Lumenis has installed more than 60,000 medical systems in doctors’ offices, clinics and operating rooms in more than 75 countries around the world. The company has over 100 FDA clearances; more than 250 registered patents & patent applications; and a team of 900 employees that work in synergy worldwide. Further, Lumenis is a truly an international organization, with direct business offices in strategic locations around the world, including the United States, UK, Germany, Israel, China, Hong Kong, India, Japan and Australia.


About the role:

As a Clinical trainer, reporting to the Clinical Training Director, you will be responsible for the development and deployment of clinical training for Lumenis customers, distributors and field employees. This position also involves overseeing every detail of training logistics to guarantee smooth and successful training sessions.


Main Duties:

  • Collaborate closely with the Clinical Training Director to implement and uphold rigorous high quality standards in training
  • Provide clinical training to existing and potential customers (digital and onsite).
  • Provide clinical training to existing and potential distributors’-affiliated clinical trainers and follow-them up
  • Coordinate all local clinical events.
  • Demonstrate use/ benefits of Lumenis products to the customers.
  • Proactive involvement with the new changing needs of digital engagement.
  • Ensure that all training programs meet the required regulations and standards.
  • Innovate the current educational offering for salesforce and customers to a digital platform.
  • contribute to the global effort in producing collaterals such as but not limited to blog, newsletter, application notes etc


Required Qualifications:

  • Experience or training in the medical device industry; preferable experience in the aesthetics field - an advantage.
  • Experience in preparing and adjusting clinical presentations as per audience and allocated time.
  • Accurate in delivering training messaging.
  • Excellent presentation skills.
  • Must be willing to travel throughout LATAM region – around 70%. and exceptionally outer LATAM
  • Interpersonal skills and professional demeanor.
  • Results- driven and self-motivated.
  • Highly organized and detail oriented.
  • Able to work independently.
  • Cooperate with others, teamwork.
  • Enthusiastic about gaining new knowledge and dedicated to self-improvement by regular engagement in professional development activities (such as but not limited to gathering clinical updates from scientific journals)
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills in English. Knowledge of Spanish and/or Portuguese will be considered an advantage

Today, Lumenis offers a wide range of products, an unparalleled technical support system, the largest global installed-base of medical laser products and one of the largest investments in research and development in the industry. Lumenis has installed more than 60,000 medical systems in doctors’ offices, clinics and operating rooms in more than 75 countries around the world. The company has over 100 FDA clearances; more than 250 registered patents & patent applications; and a team of 900 employees that work in synergy worldwide. Further, Lumenis is a truly an international organization, with direct business offices in strategic locations around the world, including the United States, UK, Germany, Israel, China, Hong Kong, India, Japan and Australia.


About the role:

As a Clinical trainer, reporting to the Clinical Training Director, you will be responsible for the development and deployment of clinical training for Lumenis customers, distributors and field employees. This position also involves overseeing every detail of training logistics to guarantee smooth and successful training sessions.


Main Duties:

  • Collaborate closely with the Clinical Training Director to implement and uphold rigorous high quality standards in training
  • Provide clinical training to existing and potential customers (digital and onsite).
  • Provide clinical training to existing and potential distributors’-affiliated clinical trainers and follow-them up
  • Coordinate all local clinical events.
  • Demonstrate use/ benefits of Lumenis products to the customers.
  • Proactive involvement with the new changing needs of digital engagement.
  • Ensure that all training programs meet the required regulations and standards.
  • Innovate the current educational offering for salesforce and customers to a digital platform.
  • contribute to the global effort in producing collaterals such as but not limited to blog, newsletter, application notes etc


Required Qualifications:

  • Experience or training in the medical device industry; preferable experience in the aesthetics field - an advantage.
  • Experience in preparing and adjusting clinical presentations as per audience and allocated time.
  • Accurate in delivering training messaging.
  • Excellent presentation skills.
  • Must be willing to travel throughout LATAM region – around 70%. and exceptionally outer LATAM
  • Interpersonal skills and professional demeanor.
  • Results- driven and self-motivated.
  • Highly organized and detail oriented.
  • Able to work independently.
  • Cooperate with others, teamwork.
  • Enthusiastic about gaining new knowledge and dedicated to self-improvement by regular engagement in professional development activities (such as but not limited to gathering clinical updates from scientific journals)
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills in English. Knowledge of Spanish and/or Portuguese will be considered an advantage

title: Senior Mobile Engineer
description:
About Us


We’re a fully-remote company distributed across the Americas with no physical headquarters. We help companies build great products that matter - that's what defines us as a group.


We’re a developer-first software development nearshore company. We prioritize building lasting partnerships with our clients. We go beyond just delivering code, we proactively bring forward solutions for challenging problems. Whether in our team augmentation model or our project model, we are dedicated to our client's success.


We’re like no other outsourcing company. We create a great environment for our developers and ensure they want to stick around, rather than switch to our clients. We treat our developers with respect and provide a culture of learning and growth.


Rockstar, ninja, guru? No, thanks.

Friendly, hardworking, thoughtful? Yes, please.


If you are a manager of one, friendly, hardworking, thoughtful, and you care deeply about doing great work, then you'll do just fine here.


Role Description


We’re looking for a Mobile Engineer with a strong experience implementing apps with the languages and frameworks created by Apple for iOS and Google for Android.


Required Qualifications


  • Strong English communication, writing and verbal.
  • 5+ years experience on native mobile development across both platforms: iOS and Android
  • iOS development with SwiftUI
  • Android development with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose


What We Offer


  • This will be a PJ hire with competitive pay in USD.
  • 100% remote work.
  • Supportive environment with 1-1 mentoring and group knowledge sharing sessions.
  • International experience working with leading startups in North America.

title: Analista IBM Planning Analytics (TM1)
description:
Objetivo da Posição


Atuar como referência técnica em IBM Planning Analytics (TM1) em ambiente corporativo ou AMS, sendo responsável pela modelagem avançada , automação de processos , desenvolvimento de relatórios e dashboards , além da otimização de performance da plataforma, garantindo qualidade, governança e aderência às necessidades do negócio .


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver, manter e otimizar cubes, dimensions, hierarquias, rules e feeders no IBM Planning Analytics (TM1).
  • Criar, gerenciar e otimizar processos TurboIntegrator (TI) para carga, integração e automação de dados.
  • Desenvolver e sustentar relatórios e dashboards utilizando PAW (Planning Analytics Workspace), Perspectives, WebSheets e Excel .
  • Garantir governança, versionamento, documentação e aplicação de melhores práticas de modelagem multidimensional.
  • Realizar integrações com ERPs corporativos (ex.: SAP, Oracle) e bancos de dados SQL/NoSQL .
  • Executar tuning de performance , análise e resolução de incidentes complexos relacionados à plataforma.
  • Atuar de forma consultiva junto às áreas de negócio, apoiando definições técnicas e funcionais.
  • Mentorar analistas Pleno e Júnior , promovendo boas práticas, padronização e evolução técnica da equipe.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência avançada em IBM Planning Analytics / TM1 .
  • Domínio de TurboIntegrator (TI) , rules , feeders e modelagem multidimensional .
  • Experiência sólida em relatórios, dashboards e automação (PAW, Perspectives, WebSheets, Excel).
  • Experiência em integrações com ERPs corporativos e bancos de dados SQL .
  • Conhecimento comprovado em tuning de performance e otimização de cubes .

title: Account Executive
description:
Job Title:  Account Executive, Brazil


Location:  Fully Remote (Brazil)

Compensation:  Competitive pay + commission


Language Requirement:  C2 proficiency in written and verbal English. Only resumes submitted in English will be considered.


About Us:

Techsalerator is transforming how organizations access, use, and monetize data. Our global data marketplace provides powerful insights that help companies innovate, optimize operations, and drive strategic growth. We are expanding our presence in Brazil and looking for a strong Hunter Minded Account Executive to help accelerate our sales efforts.


Position Overview:

The Account Executive will drive revenue growth by managing the full sales cycle, from prospecting to closing deals. This is a quota-carrying role requiring a hands-on seller with strong forecasting skills and a proven track record in B2B sales. You will report directly to the VP of Sales and work closely with the global team to expand our client base.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve and exceed revenue targets.
  • Identify, engage, and nurture relationships with prospective clients.
  • Manage the full sales cycle, from lead generation to closing.
  • Collaborate with the sales team to share best practices and improve performance.
  • Provide consistent updates on sales activity, pipeline health, and forecasts.


Qualifications:

  • Minimum 3 years of sales experience, including 2+ years of closing experience.
  • Experience selling data solutions is a plus.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to meet or exceed sales targets.
  • Fluent English (C2 level).
  • Based in Brazil with the ability to work fully remote.


What We Offer:

  • Competitive pay + commission with high earning potential.
  • Professional growth and advancement opportunities.
  • A collaborative, innovative, and supportive work environment.
  • Flexible work arrangements that support work-life balance.


Abilities and Other Requirements

In order to successfully perform the essential functions of this job the employee must be able to verbally communicate with employees, co-workers and customers online and by phone.

Disclaimer: The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by associates assigned to this classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. All personnel may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed. Techsalerator is committed to providing equal employment opportunity without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status with respect to recruitment, hiring, promotion and other terms and conditions of employment.

title: EOS Linux Server Manager (Inglês Avançado)
description:
LINUX SERVER MANAGER FOR ENHANCED OPERATIONS SERVICE


We are looking for professionals with extensive experience in Linux and Unix, and public Cloud, for support in Professional Services.

The ideal candidate has deep understanding of Cloud operations, being able to give L3 support, acting in a big team, dedicated to help clients. We need someone able to solve critical and high-impact issues independently.

A customer first mindset is a must.


• Participate in Major incident handling, troubleshoot service request failures, downtime extensions, long running ongoing incidents for a customer. (Level 3 support)

• Quick responses during escalations, take proactive steps to avoid escalations, identifying and driving initiatives to improve the operation and stability for our customer system

• Drive initiatives to standardize and simplify server operations.

• Continuous improvement methodologies: root cause analysis for Service requests failures/outages, performance issues

• Analyze root-causes of the failures (if known) in achieving the KPIS and define a corrective action plan, with well-defined mitigation steps.

• Coordinate and orchestrate the work between the various teams, collaborating with other units within and outside Enterprise Cloud Service units.

• Process improvement initiatives for daily operational activities

• Streamline standard operating procedures by focusing on automation enhancements.

• Proactive Operation services for the customer and service on-demand with timely alert reduction program to all the stakeholders involving the customer.

SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

• Technically skilled in providing expert support for all Linux OS/Windows and Infra customer issues (Expert Linux Administrator).

• Strong experience in administration of our cloud platform based on Linux operating systems in Azure, AWS and Google Cloud as well as in SAP data centres.

• Pacemaker administration knowledge.

• Practical experience with OS operation, upgrades and security patching

• Networking experience with the suite of TCP/IP, IP routing, NAT, firewalls

• Experience with network services like DNS and LDAP and HTTP proxies

• Good understanding of IT security, OS hardening

• Experience in script programming (Shell, Perl, Python, Go) and with server automation tools (Ansible, CHEF)

• Experience with server operations in large environments and in public clouds.

• Experience in Problem Management, Root cause analysis methodologies

EDUCATION AND QUALIFICATIONS

• 8+ years of related professional experience

• Bachelor’s degree or higher (Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technologies Management)

• Good analytical and solution-oriented thinking

• Very good communication

• Experience of safeguarding customer relationship and strong customer service focus

• Fluency in English



We are digital changemakers – here to disrupt old ideas, blaze new trails, and help enterprises transform and scale at unparalleled speed.

title: Software Engineer (Big Data)
description:
Big Data Engineer (Java/Python Backend) - Recomendation Platforms

São Paulo, Brazil

Contract Duration: September 2025 – March 2026

Compensation: ~$2,200 USD/month (as FTE)


What You’ll Do

  • Develop and enhance backend services using Java or Python , contributing across the full product lifecycle.
  • Work directly with Big Data pipelines using Hadoop, MapReduce, and Spark (current systems run on MapReduce, with active migration to Spark).
  • Collaborate with product, design, and client teams to understand user impact and translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Improve performance, reliability, and maintainability of large-scale distributed systems.
  • Apply automation where beneficial and contribute to continuous system improvements.
  • Communicate technical decisions clearly, including the ability to describe and interpret system diagrams and architectural flows.


What We’re Looking For

  • 3–5 years of experience in backend engineering with strong proficiency in Java/Python .
  • Hands-on experience with Big Data technologies : Hadoop, Spark, and/or MapReduce.
  • Ability to build, optimize, and maintain distributed systems that handle large data volumes.
  • Strong communication skills, especially to explain architecture, data flow, and user impact.
  • Experience working on consumer-facing or large-scale product environments .
  • Familiarity with Big Data tooling (e.g., Power BI, data pipelines) is a plus.
  • Experience with basic automation is helpful (testing is not a core requirement).

Who Will Thrive in This Role

  • Engineers who have real hands-on Big Data experience—not just surface-level exposure.
  • Professionals who understand how backend decisions affect user experience.
  • Those with experience in industries similar to large-scale consumer tech, social platforms, AI-driven products, or high-traffic data ecosystems (e.g., recommendation systems, content discovery, digital media platforms).

title: Senior Solution Architect (Remote)
description:
Olá!

A Aggrandize nasceu em 2015 com a missão de engrandecer pessoas e negócios . Guiados por valores como adaptabilidade, colaboração, foco no cliente e visão de dono, oferecemos soluções que transformam desafios em oportunidades.

Somos especialistas em Platform Engineering , Data Analytics , Modern Applications e Cybersecurity , sempre com o compromisso de impulsionar o crescimento e a inovação de nossos parceiros.

Nosso trabalho é mais do que tecnologia; é sobre potencializar resultados. Increase the power of your business .

Agora que você conhece a cultura Aggrandize, saiba mais sobre a oportunidade:


❇️ Descrição:

Você liderará decisões arquiteturais de produtos e plataformas críticas, definindo conceitos fundamentais, elementos e relações do sistema conforme boas práticas de arquitetura. Você conectará estratégia de produto a soluções cloud‑native escaláveis, seguras e observáveis, promovendo governança técnica, redução de dívida e eficiência de custos (FinOps).


❇️ O seu papel no time:

  • Definir e evoluir arquitetura (microserviços/event‑driven, APIs) com ADRs (Architecture Decision Records), padrões e guias — reduzindo retrabalho e melhorando coerência entre equipes.
  • Estabelecer SLIs/SLOs (Service Level Indicators / Service Level Objectives) e observabilidade (logs, métricas, traces com OpenTelemetry) para diagnóstico ágil e MTTR menor.
  • Planejar capacidade, desempenho e resiliência (caching, tolerância a falhas, back‑pressure) — melhorando disponibilidade.
  • Eleger tecnologias (Azure/AWS/GCP, bancos relacionais/noSQL, mensageria) com análise de trade‑offs e custo total de propriedade.
  • Governança técnica: promover boas práticas (DDD, testes, segurança por design), revisões arquiteturais e quality gates em CI/CD.
  • Segurança/Privacidade: aplicar OAuth2/OIDC, criptografia, gestão de segredos e princípios LGPD.
  • FinOps: co‑liderar otimização de uso e rates (tagueamento, unit economics), equilibrando custo vs. performance.
  • Mentoria e influência: apoiar tech leads, alinhar com PO/PM, SRE/Operações e Segurança; comunicar riscos, dependências e impactos.


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Hard Skills:

  • Arquiteturas distribuídas (microserviços, event‑driven) e APIs REST/GraphQL.
  • Event‑driven architecture: modelar domínios e eventos, Kafka (tópicos/partições, schema registry, DLQ), RabbitMQ — aumentando resiliência e throughput.
  • Plataformas de integração: Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) e/ou OSB/ODI/CDC (OGG).
  • Cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP), Containers & Orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes) e IaC (Terraform/Helm).
  • Observabilidade e SLIs/SLOs; instrumentação e dashboards (ex.: Prometheus/Grafana/OpenTelemetry).
  • CI/CD (GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps/GitLab), qualidade (SonarQube) e segurança (SAST/DAST).
  • Bancos de dados (PostgreSQL/MongoDB/Redis), modelagem e performance.
  • Segurança por design e LGPD.


❇️ Formação Acadêmica:

  • Graduação em Computação/Engenharia de Software/SI (ou experiência equivalente).


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Soft Skills:

  • Comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e de negócio
  • Colaboração e influência sem autoridade; facilitação de decisões
  • Pensamento sistêmico e análise de trade‑offs; mentoria
  • Adaptabilidade
  • Colaboração
  • Foco no cliente
  • Visão de dono


❇️ Qualificações preferenciais:

  • Event sourcing, sagas, gRPC, estratégias blue/green/canary.
  • Práticas SRE (erro budget, post‑mortem) e FinOps avançado.
  • Certificações: Cloud Architect (AWS/Azure/GCP), CKA/CKAD, TOGAF (contexto EA), DASA/DevOps, SRE.


✨O que oferecemos (modalidade CLT):

  • VR/VA de R$38/dia (cartão flexível);
  • Auxílio flex de R$210/mês (cartão flexível);
  • TotalPass;
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • PLR;
  • Day off de aniversário;
  • Treinamentos e certificações custeadas pela Aggrandize;
  • Programa de indicação premiada;
  • Trilha de carreira.

A Aggrandize nasceu em 2015 com a missão de engrandecer pessoas e negócios . Guiados por valores como adaptabilidade, colaboração, foco no cliente e visão de dono, oferecemos soluções que transformam desafios em oportunidades.

Somos especialistas em Platform Engineering , Data Analytics , Modern Applications e Cybersecurity , sempre com o compromisso de impulsionar o crescimento e a inovação de nossos parceiros.

Nosso trabalho é mais do que tecnologia; é sobre potencializar resultados. Increase the power of your business .

Agora que você conhece a cultura Aggrandize, saiba mais sobre a oportunidade:


❇️ Descrição:

Você liderará decisões arquiteturais de produtos e plataformas críticas, definindo conceitos fundamentais, elementos e relações do sistema conforme boas práticas de arquitetura. Você conectará estratégia de produto a soluções cloud‑native escaláveis, seguras e observáveis, promovendo governança técnica, redução de dívida e eficiência de custos (FinOps).


❇️ O seu papel no time:

  • Definir e evoluir arquitetura (microserviços/event‑driven, APIs) com ADRs (Architecture Decision Records), padrões e guias — reduzindo retrabalho e melhorando coerência entre equipes.
  • Estabelecer SLIs/SLOs (Service Level Indicators / Service Level Objectives) e observabilidade (logs, métricas, traces com OpenTelemetry) para diagnóstico ágil e MTTR menor.
  • Planejar capacidade, desempenho e resiliência (caching, tolerância a falhas, back‑pressure) — melhorando disponibilidade.
  • Eleger tecnologias (Azure/AWS/GCP, bancos relacionais/noSQL, mensageria) com análise de trade‑offs e custo total de propriedade.
  • Governança técnica: promover boas práticas (DDD, testes, segurança por design), revisões arquiteturais e quality gates em CI/CD.
  • Segurança/Privacidade: aplicar OAuth2/OIDC, criptografia, gestão de segredos e princípios LGPD.
  • FinOps: co‑liderar otimização de uso e rates (tagueamento, unit economics), equilibrando custo vs. performance.
  • Mentoria e influência: apoiar tech leads, alinhar com PO/PM, SRE/Operações e Segurança; comunicar riscos, dependências e impactos.


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Hard Skills:

  • Arquiteturas distribuídas (microserviços, event‑driven) e APIs REST/GraphQL.
  • Event‑driven architecture: modelar domínios e eventos, Kafka (tópicos/partições, schema registry, DLQ), RabbitMQ — aumentando resiliência e throughput.
  • Plataformas de integração: Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) e/ou OSB/ODI/CDC (OGG).
  • Cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP), Containers & Orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes) e IaC (Terraform/Helm).
  • Observabilidade e SLIs/SLOs; instrumentação e dashboards (ex.: Prometheus/Grafana/OpenTelemetry).
  • CI/CD (GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps/GitLab), qualidade (SonarQube) e segurança (SAST/DAST).
  • Bancos de dados (PostgreSQL/MongoDB/Redis), modelagem e performance.
  • Segurança por design e LGPD.


❇️ Formação Acadêmica:

  • Graduação em Computação/Engenharia de Software/SI (ou experiência equivalente).


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Soft Skills:

  • Comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e de negócio
  • Colaboração e influência sem autoridade; facilitação de decisões
  • Pensamento sistêmico e análise de trade‑offs; mentoria
  • Adaptabilidade
  • Colaboração
  • Foco no cliente
  • Visão de dono


❇️ Qualificações preferenciais:

  • Event sourcing, sagas, gRPC, estratégias blue/green/canary.
  • Práticas SRE (erro budget, post‑mortem) e FinOps avançado.
  • Certificações: Cloud Architect (AWS/Azure/GCP), CKA/CKAD, TOGAF (contexto EA), DASA/DevOps, SRE.


✨O que oferecemos (modalidade CLT):

  • VR/VA de R$38/dia (cartão flexível);
  • Auxílio flex de R$210/mês (cartão flexível);
  • TotalPass;
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • PLR;
  • Day off de aniversário;
  • Treinamentos e certificações custeadas pela Aggrandize;
  • Programa de indicação premiada;
  • Trilha de carreira.

title: Data Management Analyst
description:
About InComm

InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.


Job Summary

We are looking for Data Management Coordinator professionals to join our team. This role is fully remote in Brazil (CLT) and offers an opportunity to work in a dynamic environment supporting critical data processes.


We are seeking Data Management Coordinator professionals to join our team in fully remote positions based in Brazil (CLT). This role supports critical data processes and requires strong attention to detail, accuracy, and collaboration across multiple teams.


While all coordinators will work within MDM processes, there are two distinct specializations :

  • Credit & Contract Administration – Responsible for managing the contract lifecycle, reviewing documentation for accuracy, performing credit checks, and ensuring proper data entry across multiple platforms.
  • Location & Administrative Maintenance – Focused on maintaining location data integrity, including new setups, updates, closures, and supporting special projects related to merchant and location administration.


Both specializations play a key role in supporting operational excellence and require the ability to meet deadlines while delivering high-quality results.


Responsibilities

  • Process assignments within standard timelines (2 business days)
  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of data in MDM systems
  • Collaborate with Sales, Account Management, and Finance teams
  • Track and report data metrics for compliance and performance


Credit & Contract Administration:

  • Review incoming contract documentation for discrepancies
  • Perform credit checks in accordance with company policy
  • Enter approved contracts into multiple systems
  • Maintain merchant documentation and follow up on pending agreements


Location & Administrative Maintenance:

  • Set up new locations and update existing records in MDM
  • Manage location name changes, moves, closures, and inactivations
  • Support special projects assigned by the Data Administration Team


Requirements

  • College degree preferred (not required)
  • Professional English communication skills
  • Strong Excel skills (VLOOKUP and report comparison functions) for MDM profile
  • Administrative experience and ORACLE knowledge for contract profile
  • Ability to learn quickly and work well in a team
  • Credit review experience is a plus


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills
  • Ability to manage repetitive tasks efficiently
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced environments
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills


Benefits

Monthly internet/mobile allowance

️ Meal and food vouchers

Annual bonus

Health and dental plan

title: Especialista em Remuneração e Orçamento
description:
Descrição


  • Responsável pela manutenção do plano remuneração, desenvolvimento carreira e gestão dos indicadores, visando contribuir para um quadro de pessoal adequado e práticas de remuneração equilibradas e em sintonia com o mercado;
  • Responsável pela gestão de dashboards e construção indicadores de RH através de ferramentas como: Excel, Power Bi;
  • Desenvolvimento e gestão de dashboards diversos, KPIs, tratamento de bases e métricas de pessoas; Garantir a manutenção e revisão das políticas de Remuneração;
  • Garantir a elaboração, manutenção e análise das descrições de cargos, bem como realizar as avaliações dos mesmos; Conduzir o processo de orçamento de pessoal e suas revisões, estruturando premissas junto aos times de Finanças, garantindo acuracidade dos cálculos;
  • Gestão dos processos anuais de remuneração, como PPR, bônus, ciclos de revisão salariais etc; Desenvolver e implantar modelos de remuneração variável para as áreas de negócios;
  • Desenvolver pesquisa de remuneração e benefícios no mercado e propor ajustes, caso necessário; Realizar a gestão do quadro de pessoal, dando suporte às áreas de negócios, a fim de garantir o melhor modelo de remuneração e estruturação das posições e cargos;
  • Elaborar e atualizar tabelas salariais, visando subsidiar as decisões estratégicas da empresa; Participar de pesquisas salarias e benchmarks de mercado, com o objetivo de manter a competitividade externa da empresa.


Requisitos

  • Superior Completo;
  • Excel Avançado;
  • Conhecimento e vivência em Metodologia de Pontos.



A Britânia valoriza a inclusão por isso, todas as nossas vagas são também destinadas às pessoas com deficiência.


Conforme a Lei nº 13.709/2018 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados, ao continuar esta conversa, respondendo à mensagem, você concede às empresas do Grupo Britânia seu consentimento para que estas, por seus colaboradores, prepostos e prestadores de serviços, realize

m o tratamento de seus dados pessoais, inclusive de dados pessoais sensíveis, constantes nas candidaturas, nos termos dos arts. 7º, I, e art. 10, I, da referida lei. A eliminação dos dados em nossos sistemas ocorrerá de forma automática no prazo de 6 (seis) meses contados da data de sua candidatura ou mediante sua solicitação através do e-mail: Tal consentimento é exclusivo para fins de candidaturas, limitando a responsabilidade das empresas do Grupo Britânia a este fim, não sendo responsáveis pelo cadastro, registro e tratamento de seus dados em redes sociais, nos sites e plataformas de oferta de vagas.

title: Salesforce Tech Lead
description:
• Vaga REMOTA
  • Contrato PJ ou Cooperado


As atividades desse cargo envolvem:

  • Liderar todo o ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento (SDLC) de projetos Salesforce: requisitos, design, desenvolvimento, testes, deploy e suporte.
  • Atuar como líder técnico, garantindo qualidade, prazos e orientando desenvolvedores juniores.
  • Colaborar diretamente com stakeholders de negócio para entendimento de requisitos, priorização de demandas e validação durante o UAT.
  • Planejamento e acompanhamento de sprints, estimativas, atribuição de tarefas e daily stand-ups.
  • Gestão de equipe offshore, assegurando alinhamento e entrega contínua.
  • Suporte e melhoria de aplicações Salesforce já existentes (bugs, performance, otimizações).


Requisitos:

  • Apex, Lightning Components (Aura/LWC), Visualforce, APIs SOAP/REST e ferramentas declarativas.
  • Forte foco em Salesforce Vlocity, com experiência em: EPC/CPQ, CLM, OmniScripts, DataRaptors, Integration Procedures (IPs).
  • Vivência com code review e deploys via GitHub e Jenkins.

title: Analista GIS Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga


  • Analisar, planejar e executar as atividades da área de Customer Success da Diretoria de Experiência do Cliente, com foco na satisfação e sucesso dos clientes.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Ajudar o cliente a alcançar os objetivos idealizados com a compra de nossa plataforma;
  • Gerir o Onboarding;
  • Upsell & Cross Sell;
  • Reuniões de tomada de decisão e projetos;
  • Propor as melhores soluções aos clientes, sejam mudanças ou manutenções;
  • Follow ups frequentes sobre o andamento do projeto dos clientes;
  • Avaliar indicadores de performance e resultados dos clientes;
  • Colher feedbacks sobre o produto ou serviço;
  • Elaborar e apresentar reports para que o cliente fique ciente de onde está e para onde vai;
  • Nutrir o cliente com informações sobre a plataforma de forma estratégica;
  • Gerenciar conflitos de expectativa, solucionando eventuais problemas e acionando as áreas envolvidas, incluindo à Qualidade Imagem para melhorias contínuas de nossos processos;
  • Garantir a utilização completa da plataforma de acordo com os objetivos do cliente;
  • Fazer a ponte entre os feedbacks dos clientes e operação/comercial/marketing/fornecedores.


Requisitos e qualificações

Formação:

  • Graduado em Ciências da Terra.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Atendimento a clientes internos e externos;
  • Conceitos básicos das metodológicas de Customer Experience e Customer Success;
  • Conhecimentos em GIS;
  • Análise e interpretação de dados;
  • Vivência em projetos;
  • Conhecimento em TI (Banco de Dados e automações com Python);
  • Conhecimento sólido em ArcGIS (ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Enterprise e aplicativos como Survey, Dashboards etc.);
  • Experiência prévia em empresas de recursos naturais ou geomarketing (ambiental, mineração, óleo e gás).


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Certificações;
  • Inglês Intermediário/Avançado;
  • Power BI;
  • Conhecimento e compreensão dos produtos e serviços oferecidos pela Imagem.

title: Especialista em Banco de Dados PostgreSQL
description:
Responsabilidades Principais


Administração e Operação do PostgreSQL

  • Gerenciar ambientes PostgreSQL (instâncias, clusters, réplicas, failover, tablespaces).
  • Garantir alta disponibilidade e resiliência das bases, incluindo configurações como streaming replication, hot standby e failover automático.
  • Execution & tuning de rotinas de manutenção: VACUUM, ANALYZE, REINDEX, ajustes de autovacuum, etc.


Performance, Tuning e Otimização

  • Investigar problemas de lentidão e gargalos.
  • Ajustar parâmetros do PostgreSQL (memory, I/O, parallelism, checkpoints, WAL, etc.).
  • Análise de planos de execução, otimização de queries, índices, particionamento, estrutura de tabelas.
  • Analisar e melhorar workloads de ETL/ELT, rotinas de carga e grande volume.


Governança e Boas Práticas

  • Definir padrões de uso, modelagem e versionamento de banco.
  • Validar e revisar arquitetura de dados com as equipes.
  • Criar guidelines e recomendações técnicas.


Monitoramento e Observabilidade

  • Avaliar e evoluir KPIs críticos: consumo de CPU/Memória, I/O, replicação, lag, long transactions, bloat, deadlocks.
  • Assegurar que alertas essenciais estão configurados corretamente (Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix, CloudWatch ou equivalente).
  • Investigar incidentes e realizar RCA (Root Cause Analysis).


Segurança e Compliance

  • Atuar em controles de acesso, roles, criptografia, auditoria e segurança das instâncias.
  • Garantir conformidade com políticas internas, LGPD e boas práticas de mercado.


Backup, Recuperação e Continuidade

  • Validar e gerenciar políticas de backup físico/lógico (pg_basebackup, pg_dump, Barman, WAL-G etc.).
  • Testar rotinas de restore e recuperação (PITR – Point in Time Recovery).
  • Garantir que RPO e RTO estão dentro do esperado.


Suporte a Times Internos

  • Auxiliar desenvolvedores e analistas na modelagem de dados, queries, índices e particionamento.
  • Apoiar times de engenharia e DevOps na evolução da infraestrutura de dados.
  • Atuar em revisões técnicas de novas implementações, mudanças ou migrações.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Forte experiência com PostgreSQL em ambientes de missão crítica.
  • Domínio de performance tuning (configuração, queries, índices e particionamento).
  • Experiência comprovada com HA/replicação, backup/restore, monitoração e troubleshooting.
  • Conhecimento dos principais mecanismos internos do PostgreSQL (WAL, autovacuum, planner, MVCC).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento (Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix, Datadog, etc.).
  • Vivência com ambientes Linux e automações.
  • Diferencial: experiência com bancos em Kubernetes (StatefulSets), operadores (Crunchy Data, Bitnami, Zalando), ou cloud providers (AWS RDS, Aurora, GCP CloudSQL).

title: Appointment Setter / Outbound Lead Generator (Remote & Commission Only)
description:
About Us


We run two online businesses in the airbnb & short term rental space:

  • GrowYourBnb – an established airbnb growth partner agency
  • AutomateYourBnb – an online software platform ( on process to be set)


We are looking for a motivated individual to help with lead generation, DM conversations, and appointment setting. Full training will be provided.


Role Responsibilities

  • Aiming to send atleast 200 qualified outbound messages per day
  • Respond to inbound Instagram enquiries and pass it to senior appointment setter to close
  • Send daily outbound messages on Instagram & LinkedIn
  • Adding new strategy with new ways to find leads ( using Google or AI)
  • Qualify leads through 1-to-1 DM conversations (training provided)
  • Manage and track leads via CRM.
  • Post Instagram Stories with Call-to-Actions
  • Daily reporting via Slack
  • Work directly with the business owner.


Working Hours

  • 5 days per week
  • 8 hours per day
  • UK time focused


Experience

  • Open to all experience levels
  • Previous outbound lead generation or appointment setting experience is a bonus
  • Have worked on sales before or enjoy doing sales.
  • Have atleast worked on a DM offer previously.


Ideal Candidate

  • Strong written English
  • Confident communicator
  • Organised and consistent
  • Comfortable using Instagram & LinkedIn
  • Willing to learn and follow systems
  • Sales


Rewards: Commission Only & No Base.


To Apply:


Send a short introduction about yourself and any previous experience with social media, sales, or lead generation.

title: Data Lead Engineer – Snowflake
description:
Title: Data Lead Engineer – Snowflake

Location: Remote Mexico/Brazi

Job Type: Contract

Responsibilities

• Technical Leadership: Provide technical direction and mentorship to a team of data engineers, ensuring best practices in coding, architecture, and data operations.

• End-to-End Ownership: Architect, implement, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines that process and transform large-scale datasets efficiently and reliably.

• Orchestration and Automation: Design scalable workflows using orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, ensuring high availability and fault tolerance.

• Data Warehouse and Lake Optimization: Lead the implementation and optimization of Snowflake and data lake technologies like Apache Iceberg for storage, query performance, and scalability.

• Real-Time and Batch Processing: Build robust systems leveraging Kafka, SQS, or similar messaging technologies for real-time and batch data processing.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Data Science, Product, and Engineering teams to define data requirements and deliver actionable insights.

• Data Governance and Security: Establish and enforce data governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and maintaining data integrity.

• Scalability and Performance: Develop strategies to optimize performance for systems processing terabytes of data daily while ensuring scalability.

• Team Building: Foster a collaborative team environment, driving skill development, career growth, and continuous learning within the team.

• Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Stay ahead of industry trends to evaluate and incorporate new tools, technologies, and methodologies into the organization.


Qualifications


Required Skills:

• 8+ years of experience in data engineering with a proven track record of leading data projects or teams.

• Strong programming skills in Python, with expertise in building and optimizing ETL pipelines.

• Extensive experience with Snowflake or equivalent data warehouses for designing schemas, optimizing queries, and managing large datasets.

• Expertise in orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, with experience in building and managing complex workflows.

• Deep understanding of messaging queues such as Kafka, AWS SQS, or similar technologies for real-time data ingestion and processing.

• Demonstrated ability to architect and implement scalable data solutions handling terabytes of data.

• Hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg for managing and optimizing data lakes.

• Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes for deploying and managing distributed systems.

• Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, including version control, deployment strategies, and automated testing.

• Proven experience working in an Agile development environment and managing cross-functional team interactions.

• Strong background in data modeling, data governance, and ensuring compliance with data security standards.

• Experience working with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP.


Preferred Skills:

• Proficiency in stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink for real-time analytics.

• Familiarity with programming languages like Scala or Java for additional engineering tasks.

• Exposure to integrating data pipelines with machine learning workflows.

• Strong analytical skills to evaluate new technologies and tools for scalability and performance.

Leadership Skills:

• Proven ability to lead and mentor data engineering teams, promoting collaboration and a culture of excellence.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to articulate complex technical concepts to stakeholders.

Strategic thinking to align data engineering efforts with business goals and objectives.

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager (Remote | Contract)


We’re looking for an experienced Project Manager to own delivery execution across complex, cross-functional initiatives in an agile engineering environment. This role sits at the center of business, product, and engineering — translating priorities into action, driving clarity, and ensuring work is delivered with quality and consistency.


This is a hands-on, client-facing role for someone who enjoys taking ownership, navigating ambiguity, and keeping teams aligned and moving.


What You’ll Do

  • Own end-to-end delivery of complex initiatives, from planning through execution and completion
  • Build and manage delivery plans, including scope, timelines, dependencies, risks, and resource coordination
  • Partner closely with engineering teams to manage work intake, backlog grooming, prioritization, and task tracking (Jira)
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders, providing clear updates and driving alignment across teams
  • Identify and mitigate risks, resolve blockers, and adjust plans as priorities evolve
  • Facilitate working sessions, stand-ups, planning meetings, and stakeholder workshops as needed
  • Support prioritization decisions by providing delivery insights, trade-offs, and impact analysis
  • Continuously improve delivery processes, tools, and ways of working to increase efficiency and predictability
  • Track and report on delivery progress using appropriate metrics and tools


What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience leading delivery for complex projects or initiatives
  • Strong experience working in agile environments (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, or similar)
  • Hands-on experience using Jira for backlog management and delivery tracking
  • Proven ability to work effectively with engineering teams and business stakeholders
  • Strong communication skills and comfort working in a client-facing role
  • Ability to operate in ambiguous environments and bring structure and clarity
  • Experience supporting prioritization, change management, and delivery trade-offs
  • Basic SQL skills and familiarity with finance or accounting concepts are a plus, but not required

title: Sr. Full-Stack Software Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $4,000 - $5,000 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a Senior Full-Stack Engineer  to join the Customer Identity (CI) team that is central to the enterprise, focused on ensuring customer data is accurate, consistent, and readily accessible. title: Analista de BI Sr. (Foco em Promo)
description:
Descrição:


Estamos buscando um Analista de BI Sênior, colaborativo, que trabalhe de forma integrada com um time de produção e com um time de tecnologia para integração de dados. Deve ter a capacidade para trabalhar em múltiplos projetos de forma simultânea, e ter proatividade para contribuir com análises de dados do mercado para criação de campanhas promocionais.


Responsabilidades:

Na parte de campanhas promocionais: estruturação e montagem de dashboards com dados completos das ações, conforme mecânica. Definição de KPIs importantes, automação de entrega, relatórios e análise dos resultados, avaliando funil de conversão e comportamento do consumidor.


Na parte de planejamento: contribuir com estudos de mercado e análises estratégicas focadas em aumento de sell in e sell out, dados mercadológicos que auxiliem o time a tomar decisões de estruturação de campanhas.


Esperamos ter uma pessoa proativa que se interesse pelos resultados e participe das tomadas de decisões, além de ser capaz de apresentar relatórios e defender seus pontos de vista.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada em agências de Promoção e Live Marketing.
  • Visão de negócios e de comunicação;
  • Power BI avançado
  • Conhecimento em ETL
  • Conhecimento Google Ads e Meta Ads
  • Conhecimento avançado em linguagem DAX
  • Experiência em análises preditivas
  • Experiência com apresentações executivas
  • Experiência e conhecimentos em Google Analytics, SQL e Pacote Office Completo


Diferenciais:

  • Boa escrita e capacidade de interface direta com o cliente.
  • Boa Organização e responsabilidade com cronogramas
  • Ter uma boa desenvoltura em apresentações e um perfil mais sênior que se atente a detalhes e realmente faça essa ponte com atendimento e cliente.
  • Operacionalização no GTM 
  • SQL
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar presencialmente em Curitiba será um grande diferencial.


Sobre a Rede Magic :

Somos um grupo de comunicação com mais de 29 anos de histórica e com características bem específicas e diferenciais frente ao mercado de live marketing. Prezamos pela entrega, temos times operacionais e de tecnologia ativos nos projetos e junto aos clientes, e, acima de tudo, cuidamos do relacionamento junto às nossas contas, com ênfase sempre na entrega, nos resultados das campanhas, e na superação das expectativas dos clientes.


Local de trabalho: Home office, com disponibilidade para reuniões externas de time e junto a clientes.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Quality Engineer with 5+ years of experience, including 2+ years of experience with test automation systems. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with product and development teams to drive quality throughout the entire software lifecycle. This role involves defining test strategies and plans, developing and executing test cases, and building automation scripts to ensure high-quality software delivery. The Senior QA Engineer will also analyze system performance and contribute to ongoing automation efforts to enhance testing efficiency and reliability.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System integrating booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems - all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand project requirements fully and ensure that test plans, methods, and strategies will cause delivered software to meet or exceed expectations
  • Drive the successful validation of large-scale systems, creating test plans, cases, and strategies, as well as driving quality assurance processes
  • Develop intelligent and efficient testing strategies to dramatically increase the ratio of internally found defects versus customer-reported defects
  • Design, develop, and maintain automation tests using the chosen frameworks
  • Plan and perform functional, E2E, and regression testing, keeping pace with the Agile team, and reporting and finding issues
  • Provide test summary reports that communicate key quality indicators, risks, and mitigations to leadership
  • Accurately estimate testing requirements for input into planning efforts
  • Enhance the test case library to increase test case coverage
  • Strive to ensure quality releases of software with no production downs and/or critical impediments to users
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to junior QA engineers


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and collaboration skills
  • 5+ years of quality assurance engineering experience working with web applications and/or SaaS applications in an Agile / Scrum environment with a strong focus on automation
  • 2+ years of experience working with Cypress or Playwright to automate UI and API tests using TypeScript and/or Java
  • Experience building and maintaining not only the tests themselves but also the infrastructure that enables the tests
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Fluent in SQL and relational databases, including experience testing relational database-backed applications
  • Familiar with CI/CD (Github Actions preferred)
  • Experience with performance testing and pressure testing
  • Motivation to achieve - must be self-directed with a high degree of initiative
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • University degree or equivalent education (a technical or engineering degree is optimal)
  • Programming Languages: JavaScript and Python
  • Others: Webdriver, Cucumber, Karate, Postman, Amazon S3, Mailtrap, Sentry, and Testrail


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members on client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.


Data Cloud Consultant

Skills:

It is desirable that the candidate has a Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant certification, and should have experience in implementing and consulting on enterprise data platforms in a customer-facing role, including design, configuration, and solution architecture.


Recommendation:

Experience in implementing and working with strategy and data modeling, including building multiple solutions on Salesforce clouds.

- Have experience in development, strategy, business analysis, pre-sales solutions, or architecture.


Job Description:

Responsible for conducting customer discussions around requirements and technical drawing.

Development of software programs by technical specifications following programming standards and procedures, performing unit tests, performing program modifications and responding to problems by diagnosing and correcting logic and coding errors.

Ensure that secure coding and UI standards and best practices are applied during development.

Provide inputs and contribute to the improvement and maintenance of applications and programs.

Leading efforts to configure, analyze, design, develop, and maintain program code and applications.

Execution of detailed and complex unit tests and secure code testing and troubleshooting.

Conducting and supporting the source code management process.

Contributing to integration, systems and performance testing and code tuning.

Participation in secure code peer reviews.

Definition and promotion of opportunities for the reuse of code, configurations, procedures and techniques.


Requirements:

Degrees in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field are preferred.

Fluency in English to conduct technical meetings with offshore team, support teams and customers outside Brazil.

Experience with Data Architecture

Experience in writing SQL queries and data modeling, as well as governance and architecture performance practice and guidelines

Proficient in migrating data from traditional applications to Salesforce using the Import Wizard and Data Loader utility

Experienced in handling multi-country deployments and managing multiple instances of Salesforce.com

Experience with setting up and customizing managed Field Service packages is a plus.

Solution Modeling - Creates, designs, and formulates models, diagrams, and documentation using IT processes, standards, tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Data Modeling - Creates, writes, and tests data models, test scripts, and build scripts using IT processes, patterns, and tools, version control, and automation

Performance tuning - Conceptualizes, analyzes, and resolves application, database, and hardware issues using IT processes, standards, and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item or solution change using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including SDLC standards, tools, and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.

Customer Focus - Building strong customer relationships and providing customer-centric solutions.

Manages complexity – Understanding complex, high-quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to solve problems effectively.

Global perspective – Take a broad view when addressing issues, using a global lens.

Action-oriented – Taking on new opportunities and difficult challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Optimizes work processes – Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.


Skills:

Knowledge of service-oriented design (SOA) principles.

Excellent oral, presentation and written communication skills.

Good interpersonal skills.

Extensive knowledge of Salesforce technology and specifically the data cloud and its features and terminologies;

Experience in positioning and implementing Salesforce Data Cloud.

Salesforce Data Cloud certifications will be a plus for this role.

Proven experience in implementation and consulting of Salesforce Data Cloud environments.
